content.comment_body: Hello, I am attempting to retrieve registers from my converter into my [product_name]. While it works, I am unsure about the process. If I remove the first line VW0 and upload to [product_name], I am unable to receive any data. Can someone explain why? Kind regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. It is not possible to read double registers using a standard analog network input. Also, your screenshot does not provide sufficient information. Do you have a link to documentation for the modbus device with its register list? Preferably in English.
Hello, I am reading a value labeled as AM2. The number 307 matches what is shown in the modbus register list: 307 = ok.
Could you clarify what you meant with your last two posts?

I would like to know precisely what the [product_name] is obtaining in AM2 with the value 307. Is this representing a portion of a register or a complete register? Also, why does removing the AM1 line result in the loss of value in AM2 as well? Kind regards, [user_name]

As mentioned earlier: The address HR 30201 refers to a double register, comprising two words (HR 30201). [product_name] reads this as an integer value (VWx), which ranges from -32,768 to 32,767. In your scenario, the value 307 is below 32,768, so the value 307 is present only in HR30202.
